findings.description: The glass coffee pot is held completely upright with a level liquid surface inside, yet a stream of coffee pours straight through the solid glass bottom/side of the carafe into the mug instead of from the spout.

The plate of toast and egg sitting in front of the man at 00:36-00:44 is completely gone in the wide shot from 01:00-01:08 (only his mug is on the counter and the waitress approaches empty-handed), then suddenly reappears on the counter at 01:09 for the waitress to pick up.
As the man's left hand slides a single folded bill onto the counter, his empty right hand reaches in from the opposite side and a second bill morphs into existence underneath his right fingers.

In the opening shot (00:00-00:09), the vehicle idling outside the diner is a white sleeper-cab semi-truck, but when the man walks out to his vehicle at 01:41, it has changed into a dark-green box truck.

While the waitress stands inside looking out the window, her reflection on the glass is angled incorrectly and remains completely frozen staring forward even as the real waitress lowers her head and turns away at 01:48-01:49.

findings.invariant_violated: solid object non-penetration and entity uniqueness
findings.description: When the waitress stands up from the stool on the customer side of the counter, she walks directly through the solid counter to the employee side while a second, identical copy of the waitress simultaneously appears in the background wiping the counter.
